entities.name: Seoul Olympic Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Seoul Olympic Museum is a museum dedicated to the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea. The museum was closed due to renovation from July 2018. The reopening date has been moved back several times. It was announced in February 2023 that it would be closed until 2026.
